title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Jensen Huang?
description:
Six real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Jensen Huang: Molotov in Berlin, Truman at Potsdam, Nixon, Reagan, and Donald Trump at the White House.

Adolf Hitler → Vyacheslav Molotov → Harry S. Truman → Richard Nixon → Ronald Reagan → Donald Trump → Jensen Huang

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Molotov: In 1940, Hitler welcomed the Soviet foreign minister, Molotov, to the Reich Chancellery in Berlin.
   Photo by Mikhail Mikhaylovich Kalashnikov, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%D0%92%D1%81%D1%82%D1%80%D0%B5%D1%87%D0%B0_%D0%9C%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B0_%D0%B8_%D0%93%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B0_%D0%B2_%D0%91%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B5._%D0%9A%D0%B0%D0%B4%D1%80_1_(%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%B2%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%81%D0%B8%D1%8F).jpg
2. Molotov → Harry Truman: In 1945, Molotov posed beside President Harry Truman at the Potsdam Conference.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Potsdam_Stalin_Truman_Gromyko_Byrnes_Molotov_1945_Jul_18.png
3. Harry Truman → Richard Nixon: In 1969, President Richard Nixon visited the former president, Harry Truman, in Missouri.
   Photo by Oliver F. Atkins, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nixon_meeting_with_former_President_Harry_S.Truman_-_NARA_-_194615.tif
4. Richard Nixon → Ronald Reagan: In 1970, Nixon hosted California's governor, Ronald Reagan, and Nancy Reagan at his home.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ronald_Reagan,_Nancy_Reagan,_Pat_Nixon,_and_Richard_Nixon_in_1970.jpg
5. Ronald Reagan → Donald Trump: In 1987, President Reagan shook hands with a young Donald Trump at a White House reception.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Ronald_Reagan_Shaking_Hands_with_Donald_Trump_at_a_Reception_for_Members_of_The_%22Friends_of_Art_and_Preservation_in_Embassies%22_Foundation_in_The_Blue_Room_-_DPLA_-_3c82cdc73bac5205a60dcc8834e9c8de.jpg
6. Donald Trump → Jensen Huang: And in 2025, at the White House, Trump stood beside Jensen Huang.
   Photo by The White House, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:P20250430JB-0891.jpg

Research notes: Germany's chancellors are too short a list for a scroll, so Hitler leaves through his 1940 Berlin talks with Molotov; the best-known copy of that meeting carries a Getty watermark, so this uses a public-domain photo from the same day.

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
